title: Agents building agents
intro: The finale: teach a coding agent two skills, state a one-sentence goal, and review what it builds.

steps.title: Skills give the CLI its hands
steps.body:
Two **skills** were prepared — themselves authored by handing docs to the Gemini CLI:

- **`adk-agent-creator`** — how to scaffold, configure and run an ADK agent (venv, `adk create`, the `agent.py` + `.env` structure, `adk run` / `adk web`).
- **`nano-banana-image-gen`** — image generation and conversational editing via the genai SDK.

Register them and the CLI knows what it's capable of.

steps.title: A goal in natural language
steps.body:
State what you want — an infographic agent that turns a blog post into an image — and the CLI activates the relevant skills, scaffolds the project, wires the env, and writes the tools and root agent into `agent.py`.

> [!warn] **Watch the build.** The point of review doesn't disappear because an agent is writing the code — verify it's making the choices your skills specified. (It did here: the skill's model recommendation overrode the CLI's own default.)

steps.title: What it built
steps.body: A single ADK `LlmAgent` whose one tool chains three functions:

points.label: fetch
points.note: fetch_blog_content(url): plain requests, truncated to ~5000 chars, logged.

points.label: generate
points.note: generate_infographic(content, feedback): Nano Banana renders — and on a retry, the prior feedback is appended to the prompt.

points.label: evaluate
points.note: evaluate_infographic: factual accuracy, spelling, aesthetic alignment → 'PASS' or specific feedback.

points.label: cap
points.note: max_attempts = 3, every step logged; after 3, return the last version rather than looping forever.

steps.title: The pattern underneath
steps.body:
This is the same discipline the hand-built agents used — generate, judge, feed feedback into the retry, cap the attempts — reconstructed by a coding agent from a one-sentence goal plus packaged capabilities.

Repeatable capability → **skill**. Goal → **agent**. Your job → **review**.

recap:
**Package capabilities as skills; let the agent write the agent; review the choices.**

- Two skills (ADK scaffolding + Nano Banana) taught the CLI what it could build.
- The generated loop: fetch → generate → evaluate → feedback-driven retry, capped at 3.
- Skill instructions override tool defaults — what you package wins.
- Less-structured inputs make the evaluate→regenerate loop earn its keep.
